items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: Harry and I were in the same class in school

ctx.x: He was a drummer. And Johnny...Johnny... Johnny something... He was a guitar player. I forget what his last name is. There was four of us who were supposed to come over.

Well, we made a time and place; you know,, one of them things. So when it come time to go to, we come to find out there wasn't nobody coming except Harry and myself. So that was all right, too. Because I told my Mama I was going to stay with some friends of Harry's mother's, and he told his Mama the same thing, he was staying with some friends of my mother!
